<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
save_safetensors(path, tensors: Mapping[str, object], *, metadata: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None) -> None
```

Part of [`evoxc.formats`](/api/evoxc/formats/)

Write `tensors` to `path` in canonical safetensors layout.

## Parameters

- `path` — Destination path (written atomically via temp file +
  `os.replace`).

- `tensors` · `Mapping[str, object]` — Mapping of tensor name to `~evoxc.core.Tensor`, numpy
  array/memmap (or anything `np.asarray` accepts).

- `metadata` · `Optional[Mapping[str, str]]` — Optional `{str: str}` header metadata.

## Raises

- `TypeError` — `tensors`/`metadata` are not mappings, or a tensor name
  is not a string.

- `PersistenceError` — A dtype the format cannot represent, non-string
  metadata, or an I/O failure.
